verdict.rationale: Figma ships concrete design-to-code paths: Code Connect maps design system components to real production code (figma-gh-1, figma-gh-2, figma-docs-60, figma-docs-25), and the MCP server can generate code from selected frames and extract variables/layout context into an IDE (figma-docs-2, figma-docs-39, figma-docs-40), with a live, working hosted MCP endpoint (figma-probe-rt-1, figma-probe-rt-2). However, hands-on community feedback shows the raw generated output is often not directly shippable — devs complain about auto-generated CSS using absolute positioning and tedious manual re-export of icons/SVGs rather than clean code (figma-comm-1, figma-comm-2, figma-comm-3), indicating real caveats before code is production-ready. Missing for 10: independent evidence that MCP/Dev Mode code output is shipped as-is without manual cleanup, and broader corroboration beyond one HN thread.
